```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false

tar_load(vct_raw)
tar_load(vct_basic)
tar_load(lst_out.cut)
tar_load(vct_cal)
tar_load(lst_out.raw)
tar_load(vct_ox_step)
tar_load(vct_ox_wlms)
tar_load(vct_ox_acti)
tar_load(fpa_merged)

len_raw <- length(vct_raw)
df_out <- config_pipeline(
  vct_raw,
  vct_basic,
  vct_cal,
  lst_out.raw,
  lst_out.cut,
  vct_ox_step,
  vct_ox_wlms,
  vct_ox_acti,
  fpa_merged
)
lgl_all <- 
  df_out |> 
  mutate(
    all = all(
      GGIR, calibration, `raw methods`, cutpoints, stepcount, walmsley, actinet, merged
    )
  ) |> 
  pull(all)
  
```

# Input

Out of `r len_raw` raw files, `r sum(lgl_all)` successfully went through the pipeline.

Below is a table listing if each major step was successful for a file (TRUE) or unsuccessful (FALSE)
